intro: Devouring Plague is a rite of instruction offered to Forsaken priests who have proven their dedication to shadow magic. Granted by Priestess Aelthalyste in the Undercity, the teaching marks an acolyte's initiation into one of the most dreaded curses woven by the undead priesthood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, friend. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
